title: Top k frequent elements
statement:
Return the k most frequent values in nums, in any order. The answer is unique.

Follow-up: better than O(n log n).
hints: Count with a hash map first.
A frequency is between 1 and n: bucket values by frequency, then read buckets from the top (or keep a min-heap of size k).
complexity: O(n) with buckets; O(n log k) with a heap

solution.explanation: Count, then bucket values by count (counts are at most n) and read the buckets from high to low until k values are collected: O(n). A size-k min-heap gives O(n log k) and is the more general tool (streams, large n).
